newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in moderate trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in moderate trade on Wednesday, with Varazdinska Banka topping the list of gainers.
* Four of 14 active issues rose, six fell and four were flat.
* Volume dipped to 6,962 shares, turnover slightly higher at 4.9 million kuna.
* Top gainer Varazdinska Banka jumped 7,000 kuna to 35,000 with only three shares sold.
* Biggest decliner brewery Karlovacka Pivovara lost 10 kuna to 225, trading eight shares.
* Most active food processor Podravka remained flat at 305 kuna on volume of 3,098 shares.
